title: Factory repo contract
description: What a repo says about itself so factory workflows can run in it. Lives at .factory/contract.json. `factory check` is the authority; this schema is for editor help.

factory.description: The factory version this repo targets. Its major.minor must match the installed factory.

stacks.description: Stack names with a file in knowledge/stacks/. Their knowledge is loaded for build and review.

setup.description: Commands that get a fresh checkout ready to run the checks, such as installing dependencies. Run once when a run claims its ticket.

verify.description: The checks every change must pass, each a shell command that exits 0 on a pass.

run.description: The one command that runs the app, for reviews that need to use it.

workflows.description: The workflows this repo turns on. Each has needs the contract must meet.

reviews.description: Which reviews a change gets, by the files it touches. A file no rule covers gets the code review.

paths.description: Path patterns: * stays in a folder, ** crosses folders.

minutesPerRun.description: An unattended run stops and asks after this long. Default 60.

maxRuns.description: How many runs may go at once, across every repo. Default 2.

pauseAtQuotaPercent.description: Unattended runs pause once this much of the 5-hour usage window is spent. Default 80.

allow.description: Extra shell commands an agent may run without asking, as Claude Code patterns (e.g. "npm run storybook *").

mcp.description: Whether agent steps load this machine's MCP servers. Default false: they cost tokens on every step. Turn on for a repo whose work needs one (for example a Unity editor server).

defaultBranch.description: The branch work starts from and PRs target. Default: what origin calls its default.
